items.summary: Pre-authentication path traversal with unsafe file upload in Check Point Security Management Server lets an unauthenticated remote attacker upload and execute arbitrary scripts. Exploited in targeted attacks since July 23 and added to CISA KEV on Sep 22 with a Sep 25 remediation deadline.

Unauthenticated remote code execution in Vanderbilt's REDCap research-data platform via public survey-link routing and crafted Data Import parameters. A public proof-of-concept is circulating, and affected medical/research instances risk PHI exposure and network footholds. Fixed in REDCap 16.0.49, 17.3.10, and 17.4.4.

Authentication bypass in IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 lets an unauthenticated remote attacker bypass IP-based access controls and access the database protection service. Disclosed Sep 18; patch proactively as no public exploit is confirmed yet.

Elevation of privilege in Microsoft Entra ID disclosed in September Patch Tuesday. A flaw in the cloud identity plane reaching near-maximum CVSS deserves priority for tenants relying on Entra for SSO and conditional access.

Elevation of privilege in Azure AI Language service, rated the maximum CVSS 10.0 in September Patch Tuesday. Cloud-service tenants should apply Microsoft's remediation as AI service flaws can expose downstream tenant data.
